question: Which physically distinct anonymous occupants repeatedly fit the same masked structural slots, and do those train-discovered substitution families preserve surrounding and downstream structural behavior in independent lanes?

maskedSlot.direction: smallest strictly larger wholly-containing observation defines the slot parent
allowedContext: parent proposal scale and anonymous proposal kind
target bounding-box position and contraction inside parent
target bounding-box aspect relation to parent
explicitlyExcluded: parent or ancestor topology that contains target pixels

occupantFingerprint.featureSelection: largest train-only variance among normalized anonymous topology features
occupantFingerprint.standardization: train mean and standard deviation only
occupantFingerprint.rareAndTransferAssignment: nearest recurring train archetype by quantized physical Hamming distance with deterministic tie break

maskedContext.exactContextKey: parent scale + train-frozen geometry bins + capped immediate-sibling count
maskedContext.distributionalContext: exact slot atoms plus anonymous parent kind and immediate sibling physical-archetype atoms

substitutability.pairScore: context cosine multiplied by log(1 + independently supported shared exact contexts)
substitutability.familyConstruction: connected components of reciprocal top-partner edges after thresholds
substitutability.crossFormEvidence: report physical Hamming distance separately so visually/topologically distant occupants can be identified inside the same functional family

primaryMeasures: same-family cross-token recurrence in the same exact masked context
within-family similarity of immediate-child physical-program distributions

nullModel.method: permute frozen token-to-family membership while preserving each token's complete physical identity, lane-specific context distribution, downstream distribution, and the discovered family-size inventory

falsifiers.noSubstitutionFamilies: If recurring physical occupants do not share masked contexts strongly enough to form reciprocal train families, functional interchangeability is not supported at this resolution.
falsifiers.noTransfer: If train-discovered families lose context coherence in holdout/control or do not exceed the frozen-family null, the apparent substitutions are Cleveland-specific structure.
falsifiers.noDownstreamPreservation: If family members share slots but not downstream child programs, they may be context alternatives rather than equivalent operations.
